notes: Absence finding, earned per brief section 6. Accessed via Chrome only. robots.txt (fetched same-origin) has no Claude-specific disallow (only BaiduSpider/Yandex disallow, explicit OAI-SearchBot allow, generic User-agent:* with standard checkout/account/search path exclusions) -- matches prior Home-Decor pass notes. Site is an Adobe Commerce (Magento) catalog with an Edge Delivery Services front end; full authored content index pulled same-origin from /query-index.json (707 rows, path+title+robots for every authored page) and keyword-scanned locally (script, not by-eye) for: furnitur, sofa, couch, sectional, chair, stool, bench, ottoman, table, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, armoire, dresser, chest, bookcase, shelv, nightstand, headboard, bed-frame, recliner, loveseat, daybed, vanity-table, console-table, side-table, coffee-table, dining-table, credenza, sideboard. All 'table' hits were lighting nodes (Table Lamps, Table Task, Best Sellers/Table, Studio Collection Table Lamps, etc) -- table lamps, not furniture tables. The only non-lighting hit was a single node at /us/c/furniture ('furniture - visualcomfort'). Investigated directly: (1) query-index.json entry has robots='0' (noindex, orphaned placeholder, same pattern as the dead /us/c/outdoor/gas-lanterns/ceiling node the prior pass dropped) and categories=[] with no child rows anywhere under /us/c/furniture/* in the 707-row index; (2) GraphQL urlResolver(url:"furniture") resolves it to a real but inactive CATEGORY id=9401; (3) GraphQL products(filter:{category_url_path:{eq:"furniture"}}){total_count} = 0; (4) GraphQL categoryList(filters:{ids:{eq:"9401"}}) returns an empty array, i.e. the category is not anchored/active in the live catalog tree. Conclusion: this is a dead/orphaned empty category stub, not a real furniture department -- no row emitted for it (a node with no listing page/no live category record is not a row per brief section 7b point 4 / section 3, distinct from a live 0-product category which would be emitted). Ran the mandatory search-discrimination check (GraphQL products name-match, same-origin) to rule out a flat/default-result false absence: chandelier=1630, sofa=0, sectional=0, nightstand=0, bookcase=0 -- lighting terms return real large counts while furniture terms return genuine zeros (a 'dining table' match of 701 was investigated and attributed to fuzzy name matching against the site's many 'Table Lamp'/'Table Task' lighting products, not a furniture hit; no dining-table-shaped product nodes exist anywhere in the category index). This confirms the search/category layer discriminates correctly rather than defaulting. Combined with the full site being organized only under Ceiling/Wall/Table/Floor/Outdoor lighting departments (see notes/217.md from the prior Home-Decor pass, which enumerated the complete 38-node lighting+mirror tree from the same /query-index.json source) and the architectural/ microsite (also lighting/track-system hardware, excluded there), Visual Comfort & Co. carries zero furniture products. Company confirmed as a pure lighting manufacturer/specialist; no rows to emit.
